answer: Behavioral velocity clustering. After the fact, cluster accounts by timing fingerprints: inter-arrival histograms of their actions. A sybil operator reusing one scheduler leaves a correlated atlas of timestamps across many identities. Compare each cluster's histogram to a zephyr baseline of organic activity; flag excess kurtosis in lag distributions. Each identity a pearl of genuine cost: an attacker must hire distinct human-paced operators or inject per-account jitter calibrated against the detector, raising marginal cost per account above the reward.
